severity: production defect, reported and NOT repaired per the standing Wave 0 instruction. No application code was modified.
location: app/gst_service.py:492 - the extras loop reads ec.amount unsigned and never calls services.signed_extra_charge_amount
mechanism: a reversal row carries the ORIGINAL amount positive (CHECK amount >= 0 forbids negatives) and every caller is required to subtract it. The GST loop does not, so a reversed charge is taxed instead of untaxed.
blast_radius: calculate_stay_amount, and therefore checkout, the invoice, settlement_balance and every report downstream of it. Compounds with each further correction of the same charge.
why_never_seen: production holds no correction or reversal row of any kind - the same fact that makes INV-D02 VACUOUS. This is the first instance anybody has been able to point at.
class: already on the register as multiple independent definitions of a financial quantity: tax_lines says one thing, compute_stay_gst computes another. First identified instance.
declared_consequence: DS-ACT-CORRECTION declares INV-C02 VIOLATED by exactly 180.00. When the defect is fixed that expectation must be re-declared with evidence.
schema_gap: tax_lines has no is_reversal and no corrects_id, so the correction pattern that exists for money has no counterpart for tax. A reversed taxed charge has no declared way to unwind its tax line.
